svg.title: Sixteen-market telecom fleet
svg.desc: A complete fleet view: every market is visible alongside the identity, team, content and policy choices that make its stack different.
svg.text: Shared definitions are instantiated into each stack. Market and hosting region are separate choices.
Each row is one stack, with separate credentials, resource identities, policy sets and lifecycle.
The fleet rail means repeated configuration delivery. It carries no telemetry and grants no cross-stack access.
Left rail: repeated baseline delivery. Rows: independent stack specifications. Regional labels are planning candidates only.
